people.name: Javan
people.line: Son of Japheth; ancestor of Greek people

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

people.name: Silas
people.line: Prominent member of the Jerusalem church, companion of Paul.

translations.web: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.
translations.bsb: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, along with a large number of God-fearing Greeks and quite a few leading women.
translations.kjv: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
translations.asv: And some of them were persuaded, and consorted with Paul and Silas, and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
